findings: Observed 36 job IDs have original starts and matching request source objects; each actual job retains exactly one request digest.

Matching fields are host, executable, args, idempotency_key and cwd. Full original request bodies and native request digest are preserved, but the request digest algorithm is explicitly not recomputed; this is not a claim of independent full acceptedRequestBinding reconstruction.
Native bytes_hex/text/offset/next_offset/size are compared, overlaps must agree, terminal stored/seen counts must match, every byte must be covered and a final EOF page is required for both streams.

Actual coverage has 27 succeeded and 8 failed strong original terminals with complete streams. Known unknown installation retains null terminal/exit and original launch_unknown starts, rather than borrowing a separate probe result.

This checker covers observed job records in the frozen inventory. It does not independently establish completeness of the final file scope or a finished archive; final builder/consumer remain required.
review_scope: Read-only original-request/start matching and lossless page-composition semantics, plus inspection of the completed original coverage result. No main/coverage replay.
